warnings: Main roof: single-slope steel pipe trusses T1 on grids 2, 3 and 4 and end frames T4 on grids 1 and 5, all running the full roof depth from 2.00 above row A (A') to 1.00 below row E (E''), bearing at rows A and E (16.00, S-10). The high end is the E side (T1 depth ~2.04 there, 0.38 at the A end; sections: +6.50 ridge-top at the E-side wall).

Secondary trusses between the T1s: T3 on row B and T2 on line D' (14.00). D' is not dimensioned on this plan; its position comes from the T1 detail (two ~1.00 panels from the E support) — span_source scaled_from_grid on T2.

Grid lines 1 and 5 print T4' at the A' end and T4 mid-length: the end-frame detail sheet S-11 draws them as two pieces (ขยาย T4 (ด้านสกัด) over the C1 columns E-A, ขยาย T4' (ด้านสกัด) the ~2.00 overhang past row A). Recorded as T4' A'-A + T4 A-E''.
BX is drawn faint (background) along row A — it belongs to the S-03 lower-roof plan and is recorded there, not here.
